# Ownership rule packs

`scan` runs these packs, in this order, on every resource that no state manages. Then it runs your `rules`. The first rule that matches sets the resource's category, owner and reason, and the finding carries the rule's ID. Turn a pack off with `scan.packs.<name>: false`. The fields and functions a `match` expression can use are on the [CEL reference](/reference/cel).

| Pack | Category | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| [aws-defaults](#aws-defaults) | `aws-managed` | 10 |
| [aws-service](#aws-service) | `aws-managed` | 15 |
| [other-iac](#other-iac) | `other-iac` | 13 |
| [derived](#derived) | `derived` | 12 |
| [ephemeral](#ephemeral) | `ignored` | 2 |
| [guards](#guards) | `guard` | 1 |

## aws-defaults

Resources AWS creates in every account and region: the default VPC and what it comes with.

Category `aws-managed`. Config key `scan.packs.aws-defaults`, on by default.

#### default-vpc {#pack-aws-defaults-default-vpc}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/default-vpc`, owner `aws`: default VPC that AWS creates in every region.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::VPC" && resource.attrs.?is_default.orValue("") == "true"
```

#### default-subnet {#pack-aws-defaults-default-subnet}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/default-subnet`, owner `aws`: default subnet of the default VPC.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::Subnet" && resource.attrs.?default_for_az.orValue("") == "true"
```

#### default-network-acl {#pack-aws-defaults-default-network-acl}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/default-network-acl`, owner `aws`: default network ACL that AWS creates with every VPC.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl" && resource.attrs.?is_default.orValue("") == "true"
```

#### default-security-group {#pack-aws-defaults-default-security-group}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/default-security-group`, owner `aws`: default security group that AWS creates with every VPC.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup" && resource.name == "default"
```

#### default-vpc-children {#pack-aws-defaults-default-vpc-children}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/default-vpc-children`, owner `aws`: internet gateway, route table or DHCP options of the default VPC.

```text
resource.type in ["AWS::EC2::InternetGateway", "AWS::EC2::RouteTable", "AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions"] && resource.relationships.exists(r, r.type == "AWS::EC2::VPC" && r.attrs.?is_default.orValue("") == "true")
```

#### apex-ns-soa {#pack-aws-defaults-apex-ns-soa}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/apex-ns-soa`, owner `aws`: NS or SOA record at a hosted zone's apex, which Route 53 creates with every zone.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::Route53::RecordSet" && resource.attrs.?apex.orValue("") == "true" && resource.attrs.?type.orValue("") in ["NS", "SOA"]
```

#### default-dhcp-options {#pack-aws-defaults-default-dhcp-options}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/default-dhcp-options`, owner `aws`: DHCP options that AWS creates with the default VPC (only domain-name and AmazonProvidedDNS).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions" && size(resource.tags) == 0 && resource.attrs.?dhcp_options.orValue("") == "domain-name-servers=AmazonProvidedDNS;domain-name=" + (resource.region == "us-east-1" ? "ec2.internal" : resource.region + ".compute.internal")
```

#### main-route-table {#pack-aws-defaults-main-route-table}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/main-route-table`, owner `aws`: main route table that AWS creates with every VPC.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::RouteTable" && resource.attrs.?main.orValue("") == "true"
```

#### regional-nat-route-table {#pack-aws-defaults-regional-nat-route-table}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/regional-nat-route-table`, owner `aws`: route table that AWS creates with a regional NAT gateway.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::RouteTable" && resource.attrs.?regional_nat_gateway.orValue("") != ""
```

#### account-defaults {#pack-aws-defaults-account-defaults}

Rule `pack/aws-defaults/account-defaults`, owner `aws`: resource that every account or region has once the service is used: default deployment configurations, capacity providers, buses, groups, workgroups, vaults, users (with ElastiCache's system-managed default.iam-user and default.iam-user-group), parameter groups, auto-defined Resolver rules and AWS-managed prefix lists.

```text
(resource.source_type == "codedeploy:deploymentconfig" || resource.type == "AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentConfig") && [resource.name, resource.id].exists(n, n.startsWith("CodeDeployDefault.")) || (resource.source_type == "appconfig:deploymentstrategy" || resource.type == "AWS::AppConfig::DeploymentStrategy") && [resource.name, resource.id].exists(n, n.startsWith("AppConfig.")) || resource.type == "AWS::Cassandra::Keyspace" && [resource.name, resource.id].exists(n, n.startsWith("system")) || (resource.source_type == "ecs:capacity-provider" || resource.type == "AWS::ECS::CapacityProvider") && [resource.name, resource.id].exists(n, n in ["FARGATE", "FARGATE_SPOT"]) || resource.type in ["AWS::Scheduler::ScheduleGroup", "AWS::Events::EventBus"] && [resource.name, resource.id].exists(n, n == "default") || resource.type in ["AWS::Route53Resolver::ResolverRule", "AWS::Route53Resolver::ResolverRuleAssociation"] && resource.id.startsWith("rslvr-autodefined-") || resource.type == "AWS::Athena::WorkGroup" && resource.name == "primary" || resource.type == "AWS::Athena::DataCatalog" && resource.name == "AwsDataCatalog" || resource.type == "AWS::Backup::BackupVault" && resource.name == "Default" || resource.type in ["AWS::XRay::Group", "AWS::XRay::SamplingRule"] && [resource.name, resource.id].exists(n, n == "Default") || resource.type in ["AWS::ElastiCache::User", "AWS::ElastiCache::UserGroup"] && (resource.name == "default" || resource.name.startsWith("default.")) || resource.type == "AWS::MemoryDB::User" && resource.name == "default" || resource.type == "AWS::MemoryDB::ACL" && resource.name == "open-access" || resource.type in ["AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup", "AWS::MemoryDB::ParameterGroup"] && resource.name.startsWith("default.") || resource.type == "AWS::RDS::OptionGroup" && resource.name.startsWith("default:") || resource.type == "AWS::EC2::PrefixList" && (resource.arn.contains(":aws:prefix-list/") || resource.name.startsWith("com.amazonaws.")) || resource.type == "AWS::AppRunner::AutoScalingConfiguration" && resource.arn.contains(":autoscalingconfiguration/DefaultConfiguration/")
```

## aws-service

Resources that AWS services, IAM Identity Center, Control Tower, StackSets and CDK bootstrap create.

Category `aws-managed`. Config key `scan.packs.aws-service`, on by default.

#### service-linked-role {#pack-aws-service-service-linked-role}

Rule `pack/aws-service/service-linked-role`, owner `aws`: service-linked role that an AWS service created.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::IAM::Role" && resource.arn.contains(":role/aws-service-role/")
```

#### sso-role {#pack-aws-service-sso-role}

Rule `pack/aws-service/sso-role`, owner `iam-identity-center`: permission set role that IAM Identity Center created.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::IAM::Role" && resource.name.startsWith("AWSReservedSSO_")
```

#### control-tower {#pack-aws-service-control-tower}

Rule `pack/aws-service/control-tower`, owner `control-tower`: created by AWS Control Tower.

```text
resource.name.startsWith("aws-controltower-") || resource.name.startsWith("AWSControlTower") || resource.arn.contains(":role/aws-controltower-") || resource.arn.contains(":role/AWSControlTower")
```

#### stacksets-execution-role {#pack-aws-service-stacksets-execution-role}

Rule `pack/aws-service/stacksets-execution-role`, owner `cloudformation-stacksets`: execution role of CloudFormation StackSets.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::IAM::Role" && (resource.name.startsWith("stacksets-exec-") || resource.name == "AWSCloudFormationStackSetExecutionRole")
```

#### aws-managed-kms-key {#pack-aws-service-aws-managed-kms-key}

Rule `pack/aws-service/aws-managed-kms-key`, owner `aws`: AWS managed KMS key (KeyManager AWS).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::KMS::Key" && resource.attrs.?key_manager.orValue("") == "AWS"
```

#### aws-kms-alias {#pack-aws-service-aws-kms-alias}

Rule `pack/aws-service/aws-kms-alias`, owner `aws`: alias of an AWS managed KMS key.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::KMS::Alias" && (resource.arn.contains(":alias/aws/") || resource.name.startsWith("alias/aws/"))
```

#### cdk-bootstrap {#pack-aws-service-cdk-bootstrap}

Rule `pack/aws-service/cdk-bootstrap`, owner `cdk`: CDK bootstrap resource (default qualifier hnb659fds).

```text
resource.name.startsWith("cdk-hnb659fds-") || resource.name.startsWith("cdktoolkit-stagingbucket-") || resource.arn.contains(":role/cdk-hnb659fds-")
```

#### eks-cluster-security-group {#pack-aws-service-eks-cluster-security-group}

Rule `pack/aws-service/eks-cluster-security-group`, owner `eks`: cluster security group that EKS creates with every cluster.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup" && resource.name.startsWith("eks-cluster-sg-") && "aws:eks:cluster-name" in resource.tags
```

#### quicksight-service-role {#pack-aws-service-quicksight-service-role}

Rule `pack/aws-service/quicksight-service-role`, owner `quicksight`: service role or policy that QuickSight created under /service-role/.

```text
resource.type in ["AWS::IAM::Role", "AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy"] && (resource.arn.contains(":role/service-role/") || resource.arn.contains(":policy/service-role/")) && (resource.name.startsWith("aws-quicksight-") || resource.name.startsWith("AWSQuickSight"))
```

#### apigateway-log-group {#pack-aws-service-apigateway-log-group}

Rule `pack/aws-service/apigateway-log-group`, owner `apigateway`: execution log group that API Gateway created.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::Logs::LogGroup" && (resource.name.startsWith("API-Gateway-Execution-Logs_") || resource.name == "/aws/apigateway/welcome")
```

#### service-linked-secret {#pack-aws-service-service-linked-secret}

Rule `pack/aws-service/service-linked-secret`, owner `aws`: secret that an AWS service created and manages (a &lt;service&gt;! name or the owningService tag).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::SecretsManager::Secret" && (resource.name.matches("^(appflow|databrew|datasync|directconnect|ecs-sc|events|marketplace-deployment|opsworks-cm|pcs|rds|redshift|s2svpn|sqlworkbench)!") || "aws:secretsmanager:owningService" in resource.tags)
```

#### log-delivery-bucket-policy {#pack-aws-service-log-delivery-bucket-policy}

Rule `pack/aws-service/log-delivery-bucket-policy`, owner `log-delivery`: bucket policy that log delivery added (only AWSLogDeliveryWrite and AWSLogDeliveryAclCheck statements).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::S3::BucketPolicy" && resource.attrs.?policy_sids.orValue("") != "" && resource.attrs.policy_sids.split(",").all(s, s.startsWith("AWSLogDeliveryWrite") || s.startsWith("AWSLogDeliveryAclCheck"))
```

#### autoscaling-managed-rule {#pack-aws-service-autoscaling-managed-rule}

Rule `pack/aws-service/autoscaling-managed-rule`, owner `autoscaling`: EventBridge rule that EC2 Auto Scaling creates and manages (ManagedBy autoscaling.amazonaws.com).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::Events::Rule" && resource.name == "AutoScalingManagedRule"
```

#### efs-automatic-backup {#pack-aws-service-efs-automatic-backup}

Rule `pack/aws-service/efs-automatic-backup`, owner `efs`: backup plan, vault or selection that Amazon EFS creates for automatic backups.

```text
resource.type in ["AWS::Backup::BackupPlan", "AWS::Backup::BackupVault", "AWS::Backup::BackupSelection"] && resource.name in ["aws/efs/automatic-backup-plan", "aws/efs/automatic-backup-vault", "aws/efs/automatic-backup-selection"]
```

#### quicksight-policy-attachment {#pack-aws-service-quicksight-policy-attachment}

Rule `pack/aws-service/quicksight-policy-attachment`, owner `quicksight`: QuickSight service policy that QuickSight attached when its data source access changed.

```text
resource.type == "Native::IAM::RolePolicyAttachment" && resource.attrs.?policy_arn.orValue("").matches(":policy/service-role/AWSQuick[Ss]ight")
```

## other-iac

Resources that another IaC tool or a Kubernetes controller manages, found by the tags it sets.

Category `other-iac`. Config key `scan.packs.other-iac`, on by default.

#### cloudformation {#pack-other-iac-cloudformation}

Rule `pack/other-iac/cloudformation`, owner `cloudformation`: tagged by a CloudFormation stack (CloudFormation, CDK, StackSets, Control Tower).

```text
"aws:cloudformation:stack-name" in resource.tags || "aws:cloudformation:stack-id" in resource.tags
```

#### pulumi {#pack-other-iac-pulumi}

Rule `pack/other-iac/pulumi`, owner `pulumi`: tagged by Pulumi.

```text
resource.tags.exists(k, k.startsWith("pulumi:"))
```

#### crossplane {#pack-other-iac-crossplane}

Rule `pack/other-iac/crossplane`, owner `crossplane`: tagged by Crossplane (crossplane-kind, crossplane-name).

```text
resource.tags.exists(k, k.startsWith("crossplane.io/") || k.startsWith("crossplane-"))
```

#### aft {#pack-other-iac-aft}

Rule `pack/other-iac/aft`, owner `aft`: created by Account Factory for Terraform.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::IAM::Role" && resource.name in ["AWSAFTAdmin", "AWSAFTExecution", "AWSAFTService"] || resource.tags.?managed_by.orValue("") == "AFT"
```

#### cloudformation-stack {#pack-other-iac-cloudformation-stack}

Rule `pack/other-iac/cloudformation-stack`, owner `cloudformation`: a CloudFormation stack is itself infrastructure as code.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::CloudFormation::Stack"
```

#### external-dns {#pack-other-iac-external-dns}

Rule `pack/other-iac/external-dns`, owner `external-dns`: record or TXT ownership record of external-dns (heritage=external-dns).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::Route53::RecordSet" && resource.attrs.?external_dns.orValue("") == "true"
```

#### aws-load-balancer-controller-rule {#pack-other-iac-aws-load-balancer-controller-rule}

Rule `pack/other-iac/aws-load-balancer-controller-rule`, owner `aws-load-balancer-controller`: security group rule that the AWS Load Balancer Controller wrote.

```text
resource.type in ["AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress", "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress"] && (resource.attrs.?controller.orValue("") == "aws-load-balancer-controller" || resource.relationships.exists(r, r.relationship == "References" && "elbv2.k8s.aws/cluster" in r.tags))
```

#### in-tree-elb-rule {#pack-other-iac-in-tree-elb-rule}

Rule `pack/other-iac/in-tree-elb-rule`, owner `cloud-provider-aws`: security group rule that the in-tree Kubernetes cloud provider wrote for an NLB.

```text
resource.type in ["AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress", "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress"] && resource.attrs.?controller.orValue("") == "cloud-provider-aws"
```

#### vpc-cni-eni {#pack-other-iac-vpc-cni-eni}

Rule `pack/other-iac/vpc-cni-eni`, owner `vpc-cni`: network interface that the Amazon VPC CNI plugin created.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::NetworkInterface" && ("eks:eni:owner" in resource.tags || "node.k8s.amazonaws.com/instance_id" in resource.tags)
```

#### ebs-csi {#pack-other-iac-ebs-csi}

Rule `pack/other-iac/ebs-csi`, owner `ebs-csi-driver`: volume or snapshot that the EBS CSI driver created.

```text
"ebs.csi.aws.com/cluster" in resource.tags
```

#### efs-csi {#pack-other-iac-efs-csi}

Rule `pack/other-iac/efs-csi`, owner `efs-csi-driver`: access point that the EFS CSI driver created.

```text
"efs.csi.aws.com/cluster" in resource.tags
```

#### ack {#pack-other-iac-ack}

Rule `pack/other-iac/ack`, owner `ack`: created by an AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK) controller.

```text
"services.k8s.aws/controller-version" in resource.tags
```

#### kubernetes {#pack-other-iac-kubernetes}

Rule `pack/other-iac/kubernetes`, owner `kubernetes`: tagged by a Kubernetes controller (cloud provider, AWS Load Balancer Controller).

```text
resource.tags.exists(k, k.startsWith("kubernetes.io/cluster/") || k.startsWith("elbv2.k8s.aws/") || k.startsWith("ingress.k8s.aws/"))
```

## derived

Resources that AWS creates as children of another resource.

Category `derived`. Config key `scan.packs.derived`, on by default.

#### service-eni {#pack-derived-service-eni}

Rule `pack/derived/service-eni`, owner `aws`: network interface that an AWS service created (requester-managed, a service interface type, an attachment owned by another account, or a Lambda or VPC CNI description).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::NetworkInterface" && (resource.attrs.?requester_managed.orValue("") == "true" || resource.attrs.?interface_type.orValue("") in ["api_gateway_managed", "aws_codestar_connections_managed", "branch", "ec2_instance_connect_endpoint", "efs", "gateway_load_balancer", "gateway_load_balancer_endpoint", "global_accelerator_managed", "iot_rules_managed", "lambda", "load_balancer", "nat_gateway", "network_load_balancer", "quicksight", "transit_gateway", "trunk", "vpc_endpoint"] || resource.attrs.?instance_owner_id.orValue(resource.account) != resource.account || ["AWS Lambda VPC ENI-", "aws-K8S-", "aws-k8s-branch-eni", "aws-k8s-trunk-eni"].exists(p, resource.attrs.?description.orValue("").startsWith(p)))
```

#### autoscaled-instance {#pack-derived-autoscaled-instance}

Rule `pack/derived/autoscaled-instance`, owner `aws`: instance launched by an Auto Scaling group, an EKS node group or Karpenter.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::Instance" && ("aws:autoscaling:groupName" in resource.tags || "eks:nodegroup-name" in resource.tags || resource.tags.exists(k, k.startsWith("karpenter.sh/")))
```

#### node-launch-template {#pack-derived-node-launch-template}

Rule `pack/derived/node-launch-template`, owner `aws`: launch template that EKS or Karpenter created.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate" && ("eks:nodegroup-name" in resource.tags || "eks:cluster-name" in resource.tags || resource.tags.exists(k, k.startsWith("karpenter.sh/") || k.startsWith("karpenter.k8s.aws/")))
```

#### ecs-task {#pack-derived-ecs-task}

Rule `pack/derived/ecs-task`, owner `aws`: task that ECS started.

```text
resource.source_type == "ecs:task"
```

#### lambda-edge-replica {#pack-derived-lambda-edge-replica}

Rule `pack/derived/lambda-edge-replica`, owner `aws`: Lambda@Edge replica of a function in us-east-1.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::Lambda::Function" && resource.region != "us-east-1" && resource.name.startsWith("us-east-1.")
```

#### derived-instance-volume {#pack-derived-derived-instance-volume}

Rule `pack/derived/derived-instance-volume`, owner `aws`: volume attached to an instance that an Auto Scaling group, EKS or Karpenter launched.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EC2::Volume" && resource.relationships.exists(r, r.type == "AWS::EC2::Instance" && ("aws:autoscaling:groupName" in r.tags || "eks:nodegroup-name" in r.tags || r.tags.exists(k, k.startsWith("karpenter.sh/"))))
```

#### backup-snapshot {#pack-derived-backup-snapshot}

Rule `pack/derived/backup-snapshot`, owner `aws-backup`: snapshot or recovery point that AWS Backup created.

```text
"aws:backup:source-resource" in resource.tags
```

#### lambda-version {#pack-derived-lambda-version}

Rule `pack/derived/lambda-version`, owner `lambda`: published version of a Lambda function a unit manages (publish = true).

```text
(resource.type == "AWS::Lambda::Version" || resource.source_type == "lambda:function/version") && resource.arn.split(":").size() == 8 && in_state("aws_lambda_function", resource.arn.split(":")[6])
```

#### rds-automated-snapshot {#pack-derived-rds-automated-snapshot}

Rule `pack/derived/rds-automated-snapshot`, owner `rds`: automated RDS snapshot or backup.

```text
resource.source_type == "rds:auto-backup" || (resource.source_type in ["rds:snapshot", "rds:cluster-snapshot"] || resource.type in ["AWS::RDS::DBSnapshot", "AWS::RDS::DBClusterSnapshot"]) && (resource.arn.contains(":snapshot:rds:") || resource.arn.contains(":cluster-snapshot:rds:"))
```

#### backup-recovery-point {#pack-derived-backup-recovery-point}

Rule `pack/derived/backup-recovery-point`, owner `aws-backup`: recovery point in a backup vault a unit manages.

```text
(resource.type == "AWS::Backup::RecoveryPoint" || resource.source_type == "backup:recovery-point") && resource.relationships.exists(r, r.type == "AWS::Backup::BackupVault" && in_state("aws_backup_vault", r.id))
```

#### addon-pod-identity-association {#pack-derived-addon-pod-identity-association}

Rule `pack/derived/addon-pod-identity-association`, owner `eks`: Pod Identity association that an EKS add-on owns (ownerArn is set).

```text
resource.type == "AWS::EKS::PodIdentityAssociation" && resource.attrs.?owner_arn.orValue("") != ""
```

#### target-tracking-alarm {#pack-derived-target-tracking-alarm}

Rule `pack/derived/target-tracking-alarm`, owner `application-autoscaling`: alarm that a target tracking scaling policy created.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm" && resource.name.startsWith("TargetTracking-")
```

## ephemeral

Short-lived or by-product resources that nobody manages on purpose.

Category `ignored`. Config key `scan.packs.ephemeral`, on by default.

#### managed-lambda-log-group {#pack-ephemeral-managed-lambda-log-group}

Rule `pack/ephemeral/managed-lambda-log-group`: log group that Lambda created for a function a unit manages.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::Logs::LogGroup" && resource.name.startsWith("/aws/lambda/") && in_state("aws_lambda_function", resource.name.substring(12))
```

#### athena-query-results {#pack-ephemeral-athena-query-results}

Rule `pack/ephemeral/athena-query-results`, owner `athena`: bucket that the Athena console created for query results.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::S3::Bucket" && resource.name.startsWith("aws-athena-query-results-")
```

## guards

Guarded resources: a user rule whose category is in never_hide never applies to them. AWS Config doesn't record whether an IAM user has a console password, so every IAM user is guarded.

A guard sets no category. A user rule whose category is listed in `scan.never_hide` doesn't apply to a guarded resource, so the resource stays unmanaged.

#### iam-user {#guard-iam-user}

Rule `guard/iam-user`: IAM users can hold long-lived credentials.

```text
resource.type == "AWS::IAM::User"
```
